title: vegan
description: A living practice of radical empathy that extends moral consideration beyond species boundaries, transforming nourishment into a continuous act of alignment between personal values and planetary interdependence. This role expresses itself through the curation of plant-based sustenance, careful supply chain discernment, and narrative reimagining, employing these material and conceptual tools to embody an ethic of care in daily existence. Operating within a fluid spectrum of commitment rather than fixed negation, this orientation allows ethical intention to meet biological necessity through evolving practices of discernment and harm reduction. Through somatic attunement to living systems and the ritualization of life-affirming choices, the vegan manifests compassion as a tangible architecture of interspecies regard. Ultimately functioning as a bridge between individual consciousness and collective liberation, this orientation utilizes everyday acts of eating, wearing, and purchasing to materially instantiate a grammar of nourishment that honors the integrity of sentient bodies.
tasks: Select plant-based foods for daily nourishment while ensuring complete nutritional adequacy.
Research supply chains to verify ingredients and products are free from animal exploitation.
Prepare meals using exclusively fruits, vegetables, grains, legumes, nuts, and seeds.
Evaluate clothing and accessory labels to avoid leather, wool, silk, and other animal derivatives.
Source household and personal care products certified free from animal testing and ingredients.
Decline food and items containing animal products in social, professional, and commercial settings.
Communicate ethical frameworks regarding interspecies empathy and harm reduction to community members.
Calculate and document reductions in environmental impact achieved through dietary and consumption choices.
Advocate for the inclusion of plant-based options in institutional cafeterias, restaurants, and events.
Cultivate mindfulness practices that deepen somatic attunement to living systems and sentient beings.
Navigate retail environments to identify packaged foods devoid of hidden animal derivatives and additives.
Plan travel and logistical arrangements to ensure consistent access to appropriate nourishment and materials.
Engage in community gardening or support local agriculture to minimize agricultural harm and foster interdependence.
Share recipes, resources, and narratives that reimagine food as an expression of compassion and ethical alignment.
Participate in public discourse to materially instantiate alternatives to speciesist consumption patterns.

psychological_profile.core_drive: The need to maintain absolute continuity between their physical existence and their ethical convictions, experiencing profound dysregulation when their body becomes a site of unwitting complicity in suffering.
psychological_profile.decision_style: They eliminate ambiguity through preemptive categorical exclusion rather than probabilistic assessment, defaulting to withdrawal or refusal when verification is impossible, trusting negative inference over hopeful accommodation.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They automatically detect traces of exploitation and violence embedded in material objects and social rituals, prioritizing the spectral presence of suffering over immediate interpersonal warmth or social fluidity.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: They instinctively reframe interactions into pedagogical opportunities, translating disagreement into evidence of systemic false consciousness; when this fails, they withdraw into moral solitude rather than compromise, carrying the loneliness of perceived clarity.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They accept high social and nutritional risk while maintaining absolute aversion to moral contamination, treating bodily deprivation as acceptable but ethical inconsistency as catastrophic.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They position themselves as the uninvited witness at the edge of communal rituals, maintaining observational distance to avoid moral contamination while seeking intense fusion with those who share their perceptual framework.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They treat institutional authority as suspect machinery requiring constant interrogation, complying only after independent ethical audit and maintaining readiness to subvert structures that normalize violence.
psychological_profile.failure_response: They experience contamination-based shame followed by aggressive information-seeking to prevent recurrence, externalizing blame toward deceptive systems while internalizing the need for hypervigilance.
value_hierarchy: Moral non-complicity even at the cost of social integration
Radical supply chain transparency even when it disrupts convenience
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically over-attribute malicious intent or moral laziness to those participating in normalized violence while underestimating structural coercion and cultural programming.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They are pulled between the imperative to extend infinite compassion to all sentient beings and the simmering contempt they feel toward humans who refuse to acknowledge suffering, creating a fracture between universal love and specific misanthropy.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not knowingly introduce the products of suffering into their body or home regardless of social coercion, medical necessity, or ancestral obligation.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: They harbor persistent resentment toward the performative casualness with which others dismiss visible suffering as mere lifestyle preference or culinary tradition.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They reject the social virtue of accommodating others' comfort through strategic silence or complicit participation, viewing politeness that masks violence as moral cowardice.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When harm occurs, their mind immediately locates the fault in obscuring systems of normalized violence and the willful ignorance of those who profit from or lazily consume the suffering of others.
